page.layout: One block of running text in a single column on the printed page, with a running head above it; faint show-through text from the facing page in the right margin, not transcribed; a signature-like line "DIXI" style numeral "DIXI" centred below the text. No notes in the margins.

main_text.p: tecedente in Conclusionem resump-nitatur: Non gaudet hisce, non c-pitur Mens, à Corpore, cum qu-tota consuevit & ferme coalui-obesa, obtusa, hebes: Nam ipsa si-non sapit, quæ à se exulat, & def-derium pulcherrimæ illius Patri-jam dudum exuit: & ordinatas illi-Repetitiones ac Rhytmos, ceu r-coctam crambem detestatur: nih-præter nauseam & vomitum ad is-parat: & Meandros illos, ingenu-suos lusus, ut tricas, ut spinas asp-cit, imo ut Maleam quamdam su-pectat: nihil præter tædia, fastidi-formidines ad ista gerit. Sed gene-rosæ Mentes exsolvunt se istis Pra-judiciis: malunt secum, quam cu-corpore versari: Et hisce Logicat-placere necessum est; Sed genu-nam Logicam: nam in spuriam i-lam merito debacchantur: illa m-hi juxta ac illis, invisa semper eri-
main_text.head: DIXI.

page.notes: The running head is printed as "ARNOLDI GEULINCX," with the page number 384. The final line "DIXI" in the scan appears as the spaced letters D I X I, rendered as a closing line. Right-margin text is show-through from the facing page and is omitted. Words cut off at the right edge of the scan (for example "c", "qu", "def", "illi") are partly hidden by the gutter shadow and are transcribed as far as legible; the cut-off endings are not reconstructed.
